title: These are small, but cute
text: These are small, but cute. They are supposed to be speckled glaze, which they are, but the specks are so few that it looks more like a defect than intentional. The little armadillos are cute.  Not sure what type of decor they go with, but I'm going to give them to my daughter when she moves to another state as a reminder of home. haha!
